sections.chapter_title: Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)
sections.text_helper: Section 27.6 "SPI interrupts" in chapter 27 (Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 856.
sections.section_content:
During SPI communication an interrupt can be generated by the following events:
• Transmit TXFIFO ready to be loaded
• Data received in Receive RXFIFO
• Master mode fault
• Overrun error
• TI frame format error
• CRC protocol error
Interrupts can be enabled and disabled separately.
